verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents that you can pull data out via its public APIs to sync to other systems, and read Klaviyo data headlessly. Events are retrievable with cursor-based pagination, which implies a developer-built, API-based export path for engagement history rather than a one-click audience export. missing for 10: a documented self-serve bulk or CSV export of contacts, explicit export of custom fields and tags, suppression-list export, confirmation of the open format, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
